description: Figure 1 is a grouped bar chart that compares the average performance and token count of the proposed CoUT method against four baseline methods across four different benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists the four methods: CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT. For each method, two bars are displayed side-by-side: a red bar representing the average accuracy in percent (on the left y-axis, ranging from 70 to 100) and a bar in a different color (orange, light blue, or green) representing the token count (on the right y-axis, ranging from 0 to 800). The specific values are: for CoT, accuracy is 91.19% and token count is 80.89; for CoD, accuracy is 88.50% and token count is 676.85; for CCoT, accuracy is 88.40% and token count is 534.24; for CoUT, accuracy is 445.91 and token count is 354.46. The chart visually demonstrates that CoUT achieves the highest accuracy while using the lowest number of tokens, indicating superior efficiency.
